title: fleet: half-state patrol token lacks checks:read for H82, and the post-stamped claim refusal advises the wrong stroke for an amendment
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Follow-up from #36203 (PR #36434, the H82 half-state and the post-stamped claim refusal). Found by the seat while landing it. Filed by the seat.

## What happens

1. `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` H82 reads `/commits/SHA/check-suites` for a claimed card's PR head. Its standing caller, `.github/workflows/half-state-patrol.yml`, grants the token `contents: read`, `issues: write` and `pull-requests: read`, and no `checks: read`. On the scheduled run the read can be refused, so H82 may report every such PR as unread rather than judge it. To be measured on a patrol run log.
2. `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` refuses a lone claim comment and prints the stroke `label-write.mjs … --add pm:dispatched --remove pm:queue --assign LOGIN`. For a claim AMENDMENT the card is already `pm:dispatched` and assigned, so that advice is wrong for the case it fires on most.

## To do

1. Read the H82 coverage line ("Claimed card PRs (H82): PR row read on N of M") on the latest scheduled patrol run. If the check-suites read is refused, add `checks: read` to the workflow's `permissions:` block and say why in its permissions note.
2. Give the claim refusal a second arm for an amendment of a card that is already dispatched, naming the stroke that fits it.

## Acceptance

- On a scheduled patrol run, H82 reads the check suites of every claimed card PR it gathers.
- A refused claim amendment prints a stroke that is right for a card already `pm:dispatched`.

Tier H: `.github/workflows/**` and `scripts/pm/**` guard instruments land on the maintainer's approval.

## Grade
p2 · domain:devx · area:fleet. A patrol that may be blind on one check, and a wrong hint.
